title: 第一卷 第4章 家中进贼，求林伯收留！
slug: 满门遗孀花甲老汉粮肉满仓
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

苏馨月颤抖着手推开堂屋门。

屋里一片狼藉。

米缸被推倒在地，缸底只剩些残渣。

放钱的陶罐被砸开，里面空空如也。

昨天剩下的那条鱼，自然也没了踪影。

“怎么会……全没了……全没了……”飞燕脸色苍白。

苏馨月靠在门框上，腿一软，险些跪倒。

她扶住门框，眼泪无声滑落。

冷清雪一言不发，走进里屋，片刻后出来，脸色无比难看：“被褥也被割破了。”

“完了……”上官飞燕瘫坐在地，喃喃道，“粮食没了，钱没了……这个冬天怎么过……”

没过多久，林骁背着弓箭走进院子，见屋门大开，三女神色凄惶，心知不妙。

“怎么了？”他快步进屋。

“林伯……”苏馨月转身，扑到他身前，哭得梨花带雨，“家里进贼了……粮食、银两……全都没了……”

上官飞燕也红了眼眶，强忍着没哭出声。

冷清雪静静站在一旁，嘴唇抿得发白。

林骁扫视屋内，脸色沉了下来。

昨晚的怪声，果然是为了将她们吓走。

趁她们离家，贼人便摸进来，将能拿的都拿走了。

林骁沉声道：“没事，一些粮食银两而已，从今往后，你们搬去我那儿住，我管你们饭吃。”

苏馨月抬起头，泪眼朦胧：“那怎么行……这会损了您的名声……”

林骁自嘲一笑：“我本来也没什么好名声，我个老头子，从不在乎旁人眼光，这年头，名声填不饱肚子，你们说呢？”

苏馨月擦了泪，用力点头：“谢林伯收留，我们不会白吃白住，定会帮忙干活。”

“什么？苏姐姐，我们要……要跟他住一起？”上官飞燕语气充满抵触。

林骁看向她：“怎么，不愿意？”

“嗯！”上官飞燕咬着唇，“我不愿意！”

“不愿意正好。”林骁语气冷酷，“多张嘴，多份口粮，我虽答应老柳照顾你们，但我也是有脾气的，你既不愿，往后自力更生吧。”

这话说得毫不客气。

上官飞燕脸色一白，嘴唇哆嗦着，说不出话。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Su Xinyue pushed open the main room door with trembling hands.

The house was in a mess.

The rice vat was pushed to the ground, leaving only some residue at the bottom.

The clay pot in which the money was kept was smashed open, and it was empty.

The remaining fish from yesterday was naturally gone.

"How could it be...it's all gone...it's all gone..." Feiyan's face turned pale.

Su Xinyue leaned against the door frame, her legs softened and she almost fell to her knees.

She held on to the door frame, tears falling silently.

Leng Qingxue walked into the back room without saying a word, and came out a moment later with an extremely ugly face: "The bedding was also cut."

"It's over..." Shangguan Feiyan collapsed on the ground and murmured, "The food is gone, the money is gone... How will we survive this winter..."

Not long after, Lin Xiao walked into the yard with a bow and arrow on his back. He saw the door of the house wide open, and the three goddesses looked miserable, knowing that something was wrong.

"What's wrong?" He quickly entered the house.

"Uncle Lin..." Su Xinyue turned around and threw herself in front of him, crying so hard, "There was a thief in the house... the food and silver... are all gone..."

Shangguan Feiyan also had red eyes and tried not to cry.

Leng Qingxue stood aside quietly, her lips turning white.

Lin Xiao glanced around the room and his expression darkened.

The strange noise last night was indeed intended to scare them away.

While they were away from home, thieves came in and took away everything they could.

Lin Xiao said in a deep voice: "It's okay, it's just some food and silver. From now on, you move to my place and I will take care of your food."

Su Xinyue raised her head with tears in her eyes: "How can that be done... This will damage your reputation..."

Lin Xiao laughed at himself: "I don't have a good reputation to begin with. I'm an old man and I never care about other people's opinions. These days, fame can't fill my stomach. What do you think?"

Su Xinyue wiped her tears and nodded vigorously: "Thank you, Uncle Lin, for taking me in. We won't live and eat for free, and we will definitely help with the work."

"What? Sister Su, we want... to live with him?" Shangguan Feiyan's tone was full of resistance.

Lin Xiao looked at her: "What, you don't want to?"

"Yeah!" Shangguan Feiyan bit her lip, "I don't want to!"

"I don't want to be lucky." Lin Xiao said in a cold tone, "Open your mouth more and get more rations. Although I promised Lao Liu to take care of you, I also have a temper. If you don't want to, just be self-reliant in the future."

This was said without politeness.

Shangguan Feiyan's face turned pale, her lips trembled, and she was speechless.
